title: Nate Holden Performing Arts Center

services.name: Our Facility/Rentals
services.desc: The Nate Holden Performing Arts Center (NHPAC) is a multi-use complex comprised of a theatre, a rehearsal hall/studio, an open air lobby complete with a box office and concession area, and two undeveloped retail areas. Perfect for performances, festivals, screenings, meetings, rehearsals and receptions, the NHPAC can accommodate your event planning needs. The Nate Holden Performing Arts Center (NHPAC) is a multi-use complex comprised of a theatre, a rehearsal hall/studio, an open-air lobby complete with a box office and concession area, a cabaret and gallery space.
